newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Oct-Dec industrial sales up 4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Danish Oct-Dec industrial sales up 4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Danish industrial sales rose four percent in current prices during October-December 1996 and orders rose three percent, compared to the same period last year, the national statistics bureau said on Friday.

The manufacturing price index rose by one percent in October-December 1996 compared to the same period last year, while the quantity index, indicating trends in turnover of goods and services, showed a two percent year-on-year gain.
The data was not seasonally adjusted.
